source_assistant: Answer should state assumptions, a falsifiable hypothesis, measurements, expected confounders, and rollback criteria. corrected_answer:
Assumptions: the hang is reproducible; this is an authorized, disposable diagnostic run; and no platform-specific cause is inferred without measurements. Hold launcher, image, payload, placement, world size, and software constant except for the named comparison. Prioritize rendezvous identity and stale-store isolation and preserve a redacted timestamped baseline.

Hypothesis: inconsistent membership, rendezvous identity, device mapping, or collective ordering leaves a rank waiting; competitors are a bad interface/route, GPU visibility/topology failure, container limits, or resource exhaustion. Falsify the primary hypothesis only when every rank reports the same fresh attempt ID, world size, unique global/local rank, host, rendezvous endpoint/address, visible device UUID, selected interface, and collective sequence, and a checksum-verified tiny all-reduce completes on every rank.

Measure first: per-rank launch/process-group arguments with secrets and private addresses redacted; rank-map and rendezvous/collective entry-exit timestamps; store reachability, DNS/routes/interfaces; CUDA and communication-library/framework versions; GPU visibility/UUIDs/topology/peer access; CPU/RAM/FD/SHM limits, placement, and timeout. Record measured values with units and label estimates or unknowns.

Controlled experiment: use a fresh authorized rendezvous namespace and bounded watchdog; run repeated randomized trials of single-node, reduced-world, and full-world with identical tiny all-reduce payload, rank logging, timeout, and cleanup. Compare only the selected factor and collect checksum correctness, initialization latency, timeout location, rank errors, transport path, and residual state. A failure following the factor supports it; success alone is not proof. Confounders include placement, retries, stale stores, route changes, contention, and warm-up.

Stop at the deadline or unsafe resource impact, clean up child ranks/process group and only authorized temporary rendezvous state, and restore prior configuration. Do not disable authentication, expose secrets, or alter production jobs. Require redacted per-rank logs, topology/device inventory, exact trial matrix, timings, and cleanup results for review; confidence is provisional.
